goal: uses a continuous heading hierarchy to express parent-child themes.
summary: page has been written. Sign-in and card collection are at the same level, and re-signing is a topic under the sign-in column.
tasks: marks "check-in arrangement" and "Card collection arrangement" as h2, and "re-signing" as h3.
